Transport Documents

Ordem de embarque

A contractual instruction issued by a carrier or forwarder, authorizing the release and shipment of specified goods; key document in booking and shipment initiation, especially in liner shipping.

Questions and answers

Questions and answers

What is Ordem de embarque?

In this glossary, Ordem de embarque refers to: A contractual instruction issued by a carrier or forwarder, authorizing the release and shipment of specified goods; key document in booking and shipment initiation, especially in liner shipping.

How is Ordem de embarque used in logistics?

In logistics communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "A ordem de embarque é apresentada ao operador do terminal para autorizar o carregamento do contêiner no navio."

Why does Ordem de embarque matter in logistics?

Ordem de embarque matters because it supports clear communication in Transport Documents contexts for Freight Forwarders, Supply Chain Managers, and Customs Brokers. It also connects to aviation training and exam language such as FIATA Diploma, CILT Certification, and IATA DGR.

Who uses Ordem de embarque?

Ordem de embarque is mainly used by Freight Forwarders, Supply Chain Managers, and Customs Brokers.

What category does Ordem de embarque belong to?

In this glossary, Ordem de embarque is grouped under Transport Documents. Related pages in this category explain adjacent procedures, commands and operational concepts.

Where does this definition come from?

This definition is sourced from Incoterms 2020 (ICC), FIATA, IATA DGR, WCO and published by Protermify Logistics as a static logistics reference page.

Definition

A contractual instruction issued by a carrier or forwarder, authorizing the release and shipment of specified goods; key document in booking and shipment initiation, especially in liner shipping.

Operational example

The shipping order is presented to the terminal operator to authorize loading the container onto the vessel.

Localized term

Ordem de embarque

Localized example

A ordem de embarque é apresentada ao operador do terminal para autorizar o carregamento do contêiner no navio.
